about_the_game:
Trash Trek Simulator is a first-person survival game that drops you into the harsh world of life on the streets. In the singleplayer mode, you play as Jergus—a man who lost everything. His only hope for a fresh start? A crazy plan from his street mentor John: dig through trash bins, collect junk, and sell it for cash.

But what happens when more scavengers dive into the same dumpster?

In multiplayer mode, you compete with friends—or rivals—in fast-paced scavenger races where you collect the most valuable loot while avoiding security. Will you team up, or sabotage others to come out on top?

Singleplayer: A brief step into the world

• The singleplayer mode is currently a basic prototype—designed as a simple intro or for a quick offline session.

• Follow Jergus’s story and complete John’s initial tasks that introduce the core gameplay.

• Content and controls in singleplayer are not final—future updates may bring expansions.

Multiplayer: Compete, cooperate, or sabotage

• Play against friends or strangers and collect the most valuable trash.

• Sabotage others or work together to outsmart the guards.

• Every match is different—adapt, survive, and become the king of the dump.

    Security Guards: The Unpaid Heroes of Trash Protection

• The SBS (security guards) patrol the area, always on the lookout for looters.

• Get caught? You either escape or lose your entire haul.

    Humor & Harsh Reality

• The game blends street survival with dark humor, highlighting the absurdities of life on the fringe of society.

• Meet Joseph, aka “Jožo”, the local drunk with a mouth that never stops running. His mind swims in alcohol, and his words make no sense, yet he keeps talking like he’s the wisest philosopher of the dumpsters.

• “I once owned a skyscraper, but I left it behind for the fresh air of the streets!” – Jožo, definitely lying.

    Future Expansions

• More locations, more dumpsters, more cities—players can look forward to new areas to explore and loot in future updates.

Will you rise from the streets or embrace the chaos? In Trash Trek Simulator, the choice is yours.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains themes of petty crime, such as scavenging from dumpsters and avoiding security guards. Players can use non-lethal weapons to temporarily disable pursuers in order to escape. The game also includes occasional references to alcohol consumption and mild crude humor. There is no graphic violence or explicit content.

short_description: Explore the world through the eyes of a homeless scavenger, rummaging through junkyards, outsmarting security, and turning trash into cash. Play solo or in chaotic multiplayer, where quick hands, smart moves, and a good sense of humor make all the difference. Laugh, hustle, and survive!
